stages.name: PHP core RCE exploitation
observables: unauthenticated HTTP request targeting PHP worker (php-fpm, mod_php, php-cgi)

scenario.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP core (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) allow attackers to gain code execution in the context of web worker processes. Post-exploitation involves web servers spawning shells for system discovery, staging second-stage payloads via interpreters, and establishing persistence through webshells or system configuration.

meta.rationale: Focus on internet-facing assets running common PHP platforms like WordPress, Magento, or custom web applications. Priority should be given to servers running mod_php or PHP-FPM without container isolation.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker is exploiting PHP core RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618/19) to force web server processes to spawn shells or interpreters, which then perform system discovery and payload staging.

hunt.name: PHP2Shell: Web-to-Shell Staging
hunt.description: This hunt targets the convergent post-exploitation footprint of PHP core vulnerabilities, where unauthenticated requests trigger a PHP worker to execute arbitrary code. The hunt begins by identifying vulnerable assets and then uses a phased approach to detect the transition from web server processes (like php-fpm or nginx) to shells and language interpreters. By stack-counting unusual parent-child relationships and corroborating them with discovery commands and staging tools, the hunt identifies active compromises where traditional static rules might be bypassed.

config.content: SELECT resource_uid, device_uid, cve_uid, severity, status FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE instr(',' || '{{cve_ids}}' || ',', ',' || cve_uid || ',') > 0 AND status != 'suppressed'
config.description: Locate hosts with active vulnerability findings for the PHP2Shell CVEs to focus the hunt.
config.expected_signal: Rows identify specific device UIDs and resources that are unpatched for the target CVEs. Silence suggests a lower exposure, but is not evidence of absence if scans are not current.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, parent_process_name, process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{web_server_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'php-fpm%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'lsphp%') AND instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect the most direct indicator of RCE: a web worker process spawning a shell.
config.expected_signal: A shell running as a child of a web server. Benign hits include maintenance scripts or scheduled backups.

primitive_config.label: Web workers spawning shells
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, parent_process_name, process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{web_server_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'php-fpm%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'lsphp%') AND instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A shell running as a child of a web server. Benign hits include maintenance scripts or scheduled backups.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(parent_process_name) AS parent, LOWER(process_name) AS child, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{web_server_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'php-fpm%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE 'lsphp%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING hosts <= 2
config.description: Stack-count children of web processes to identify rare pivots across the fleet that behavior rules might miss.
config.expected_signal: One or two hosts where a web process spawns an unusual child. Silence means the web tier behaves uniformly across the fleet.
